description: Implement all core UI sections: Header, Hero, Stats Bar, About, Shop, Esports/Lifestyle, Race Calendar, and Footer. Each section follows the design spec with dark aesthetic, neon accents, Unsplash placeholders, and Framer Motion animations.
steps: Create components/Header.tsx: Sticky header that starts transparent, transitions to dark blur (backdrop-blur-lg bg-black/80) on scroll using a useState + useEffect scroll listener. Left: brand logo text in neon color (bold uppercase). Center: nav links (Home, About, Shop, Esports, Calendar) with hover underline animation. Right: social icons (Instagram, Twitter/X, YouTube) as SVG icons. Include a mobile hamburger menu that opens a full-screen overlay nav with Framer Motion slide-in animation.

Create components/Hero.tsx: Full-screen section (h-screen) with a dark moody background image from Unsplash (motorsport query, e.g. https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1568605117036-5fe5e7bab0b7?w=1920&q=80) with a dark gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-black via-black/60 to-transparent). Massive uppercase heading with the name (e.g., 'DRIVER. CREATOR. ICON.'). Two CTA buttons: 'Shop Latest Collection' (bg-neon text-black font-bold px-8 py-4 rounded-none uppercase) and 'View Race Calendar' (border-2 border-neon text-neon px-8 py-4 rounded-none uppercase hover:bg-neon hover:text-black transition). Add Framer Motion fade-up animation on mount.

Create components/StatsBar.tsx: Section below hero with either a CSS marquee animation (infinite scroll) or a 3-column grid. Display stats like '8 Race Wins', '25 Podiums', '4 Pole Positions' in large bold neon numbers with white labels below. Use Framer Motion whileInView for entrance animation.

Create components/About.tsx: Asymmetrical two-column layout (60/40 split). Left: large action shot from Unsplash (sports car or motorsport). Right: punchy biographical text with uppercase heading 'THE STORY', body text in gray-300, and an animated 'Read Full Story' link that has an arrow sliding right on hover using Framer Motion.

Create components/Shop.tsx: Dark section with uppercase heading 'LATEST DROP'. Horizontal scrollable carousel (overflow-x-auto with snap-x) showing 4-6 product cards. Each card: dark charcoal background, Unsplash streetwear fashion image, product name, price. On hover: image scales up (scale-105 transition), and a neon 'ADD TO CART' button fades in overlay. Use Framer Motion for staggered entrance animation.

Create components/Esports.tsx: Distinct section with a subtle halftone/grid texture background (CSS pattern or SVG overlay). Contains: section heading 'BEYOND THE TRACK', a placeholder embedded video (YouTube iframe or dark placeholder box with play button), description text about gaming/lifestyle brand, and a CTA button 'Explore Quadrant' styled in neon.

Create components/RaceCalendar.tsx: Section with heading 'NEXT RACE'. A single prominent card with: track name (e.g., 'Monaco Grand Prix'), location and date, a placeholder track map image from Unsplash, and a live countdown timer (days/hours/minutes/seconds) implemented with useState + useEffect setInterval. Countdown styled with large neon numbers in grid boxes.

Create components/Footer.tsx: Large section with: newsletter signup block (heading 'JOIN THE COMMUNITY', dark input field with placeholder 'Enter your email', neon submit button 'SUBSCRIBE'). Below: large repeated brand name in massive outlined/stroke typography. Bottom row: copyright, social links, legal links. All on deep black background.
Update app/page.tsx to import and render all components in order: Header, Hero, StatsBar, About, Shop, Esports, RaceCalendar, Footer.

Add scroll-based animations throughout: use Framer Motion's useInView or whileInView with variants for fade-up (opacity 0 to 1, y 30 to 0) on section entrance. Add subtle parallax effect on the Hero background image using Framer Motion useScroll + useTransform.

Ensure full mobile responsiveness: all grids collapse to single column on mobile, text sizes reduce appropriately, Shop carousel is touch-scrollable, Header switches to hamburger menu below md breakpoint.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 sections render correctly on the page
Hero displays full-screen with gradient overlay and two distinct CTA buttons
Shop carousel is horizontally scrollable with hover effects
Race Calendar shows a live countdown timer that ticks down
Footer has a functional-looking newsletter signup form
Mobile hamburger menu opens/closes with animation
Framer Motion animations trigger on scroll into viewport
